caption: Primary extension paths and their required registry/profile follow-through, including the release-version route.
code:
flowchart LR
  Rule["New rule"] --> Owner["canonical owner package"]
  Owner --> Registry["requirements and graph registries"]
  Owner --> Enforcement["validator/runtime check if executable"]
  Capability["New capability"] --> CapRoot["02_capabilities"]
  CapRoot --> CapMgr["capability_manager"]
  Adapter["New adapter"] --> AdapterRoot["05_platform_adapters/<adapter>"]
  AdapterRoot --> PAIndex["PROFILE_ADAPTER_INDEX"]
  CapMgr --> Profiles["opt-in profiles"]
  PAIndex --> Profiles
  Version["Change the release version"] --> VersionFile["VERSION"]
  VersionFile --> VersionPins["release_integrity constants, FRAMEWORK.json, schemas,
module manifests, module narratives, TEST_MANIFEST, governance"]
  VersionPins --> Allowlist["RELEASE_ALLOWLIST.json regenerated last"]
insight: Rules begin at one canonical semantic owner, capabilities remain under the capability layer, host translation remains isolated under platform adapters, and a version bump routes through every pin before the allowlist.
